# Machine capabilities

<!-- GENERATED by `python3 port/h100/machine.py capabilities --out port/machines/capabilities.md`: do not edit -->

What each GPU machine profile can run (ADR-006 rev 2, phase S0-00). Every value is derived by
`port/h100/machine.py` from the detected numbers (GPU memory, count, compute capability, host cores),
never from the profile name, so a machine that is not listed gets its column from the same rules:
`bash port/h100/machine.sh detect` prints it.

| Item | Rule | `a100-40x2` | `a100-80x1` | `h100-80x2` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GPUs | detected | 2 × NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB | 1 × NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe | 2 × NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 |
| Compute capability | ≥ 8.0, else stop | 8.0 | 8.0 | 9.0 |
| Memory gate G-MEM | peak ≤ 85 % of one GPU's memory | 34 GB | 68 GB | 68 GB |
| `eaton_small` on one GPU | memory estimate (RRTMG 4096, else 2048) ≤ G-MEM | yes (24.2 GB, 4096) | yes (24.2 GB, 4096) | yes (25.7 GB, 4096) |
| `eaton_mid` on one GPU | memory estimate (RRTMG 4096, else 2048) ≤ G-MEM | yes (33.9 GB, 2048) | yes (36.1 GB, 4096) | yes (37.6 GB, 4096) |
| `eaton_full` on one GPU | memory estimate (RRTMG 4096, else 2048) ≤ G-MEM | no (52.9 GB, 2048) | yes (55.1 GB, 4096) | yes (56.6 GB, 4096) |
| Runs at once | one per GPU | 2 | 1 | 2 |
| "GPU 0 equals GPU 1" checks | on two GPUs, else the same GPU twice | two GPUs | same GPU twice | two GPUs |
| Acceptance G5 | `eaton_mid` always; the full case where it fits one GPU | `eaton_mid` | `eaton_mid` + `eaton_full` | `eaton_mid` + `eaton_full` |
| Full case | one GPU if it fits, else multi-GPU | multi-GPU (S8-01 ... S8-05) | one GPU | one GPU (multi-GPU if N >= 2) |
| Multi-GPU phases S8-01 … S8-05 | ≥ 2 GPUs | yes | no | yes |
| H100-only optimizations | cc ≥ 9.0 | no | no | yes |
| CPU reference ranks | 1, n/4, n/2, n host cores | 1, 14, 28, 56 | 1, 8, 16, 32 | 1, 28, 56, 112 |
| BUILD_JOBS | host cores, at most RAM/4 GB | 56 | 32 | 112 |

Notes:
- Memory estimates: `port/gpu_mem_estimate.py` with resident threads = SMs × 2048 of the GPU model. `eaton_small` is the full case with d02 181×181 until S0-09.1 writes `cases/eaton_small/`; it must also stay within 25 GB on every profile.
- `eaton_mid` is sized by the same tool: the largest d02 (n = 9k + 1) of the full case whose estimate fits the gate of one 40 GB GPU. Estimated d02: 550×550. S0-09.5 decides and writes `cases/eaton_mid/`.
- A GPU below compute capability 8.0 stops every script (sample `v100-16x1`).

Samples the table is computed from (`port/machines/samples/`):

- `a100-40x2`: recorded 2026-10-10 on the owner's workstation (GPU UUIDs anonymized)
- `a100-80x1`: constructed from vendor specifications (not a capture); replace with a real capture when this profile is first seen
- `h100-80x2`: constructed from vendor specifications (not a capture); replace with a real capture when this profile is first seen
- `v100-16x1`: constructed: a GPU below cc 8.0, which the scripts must refuse (test only, not a profile) → stops: compute capability 7.0 < 8.0: the build targets cc80 and cc90 only
